(8) In this section—
“school premises” means land used for the purposes of a school excluding
any land occupied solely as a dwelling by a person employed at the school; and
“school” has the same meaning—
(a) in England and Wales, as in section 4 of the Education Act 1996;
(b) in Scotland, as in section 135(1) of the Education (Scotland) Act 1980;
(c) in Northern Ireland, as in Article 2(2) of the Education and Libraries
(Northern Ireland) Order 1986.
